svg.title: Octobot 2.0 VEGA Services AI Architecture
svg.desc: High-level architecture for the live VEGA chatbot. Inside the Citi network, the VEGA experience connects through the Chatbot BFF to the Services AI platform, where the root orchestrator routes Asset Services and Transaction Management requests to five active MCP tools. R2D2 provides approved model access across the external-services boundary. A compact Services AI feedback endpoint, shared data and services, and supporting platform capabilities are also shown.

g.text: Live AS + TM operations chatbot, governed agent execution, approved model access, and platform services
Independent AS / TM execution; BOTH supported
TYPED VALIDATION, FIELD MAPPING, AUTH AND SAFE ERRORS
MODEL ACCESS ONLY - NO PROVIDER DATA
Primary request flow remains separate from model access, platform data, and user feedback.
